title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
content: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
content: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.

title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
content: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

title: How will Saudi Arabia deal with the Houthis?
content: Yemeni group warns of further attacks on the kingdom.

title: Man Utd salvage Fulham draw as pressure mounts on Carrick
content: Matheus Cunha strikes late as Manchester United seal a 1-1 draw at Fulham, but pressure mounts on Michael Carrick.

title: Gaza artists honour Macklemore for supporting Palestine
content: Artists in Gaza are painting murals on destroyed walls, honouring US rapper Macklemore for his support for Palestine.
